answer: Path Weight Decay anchors an identity's fee weight to its 90-day distinct-counterparty count. The rule multiplies per-tx fees by √(new IDs in the same garden batch), so 500 sybils in one batch costs 22× per transaction. Baseline cost is $0.003/identity/hr; at 1,000 concurrent sybils the fee climbs the ridge to $0.65/identity/hr.
